Peas are a gut-health MVP: they bring fiber that helps keep digestion moving, plus prebiotic fibers that feed your beneficial gut bacteria. They also contain resistant starch and fermentable carbs that can support a healthier microbiome.

And here’s what makes them even more valuable—those fermentable fibers get broken down by your gut microbes into short-chain fatty acids like butyrate, which help nourish your gut lining, reduce inflammation, and support overall gut function. On top of that, peas provide plant-based protein and polyphenols that further support microbial diversity and metabolic health.

Start with our enzyme rich foods.
So enzymes are little proteins that help you to break down and digest food.
When you increase enzyme rich foods in your diet,
you help your gut digest better.
It'll stop bloating before it even happens.
My favourite enzyme rich foods to tell people to include are kiwis,
papayas and pineapple. There's actually a lot of research on two kiwis a day
being one of the most helpful things that you can do to heal I B S.
PROBIOTIC RICH FOODS
Now we're moving on to probiotic rich foods.
And probiotic rich foods can also be high in enzymes,
like sauerkraut, kimchi or kefir.
Only need about a tablespoon of these foods everyday,
so don't overdo it, you can tolerate it.
I also really like a two yoghurt that's filled with probiotics for the gut.

Adding in good bacteria can help alleviate digestive symptoms,
and you don't necessarily have to take a probiotic supplement to do that.
EAST TO DIGEST FIBER RICH FOODS
Now let's talk fibre rich foods.
You wanna include a lot of fibre, so That it feeds the good bacteria in your gut and it keeps things moving.
Stagnation in the gut breeds bloating,
gas and constipation. You kill two birds with one stone with kiwis.
Both a high enzyme food and also a high fibre food.
Some other high fibre foods that are easy to digest and generally well tolerated
are sweet potatoes, oats,
brown rice and quinoa.
GASTRIC JUICE PROMOTING FOODS
We have our gastric juice promoting foods.
The more you can increase gastric juice production,
the better your digestion is gonna be and the less bloating you're gonna have.
This is gonna be apple cider vinegar.
Bitter foods like kale, arugula,
dandelion. And no, you don't have to eat a whole salad of these things,
but just chewing on them a little bit before you eat a meal
is going to be super helpful.
ANTI-INFLAMMATORY/ SOOTHING FOODS
And lastly, we have our anti inflammatory foods.
These are foods that actually soothe and repair the lining of the gut.
Bone broth is my number one.
You can get bone broth powders and drink them.
Uh, I know Costco has one. Just ingredients has one that I drink every single morning.
I think it's delicious. Make your own bone broth using a chicken carcass.
Anytime I make, like, a whole chicken or I buy a rotisserie chicken,
I will make bone broth with that.
I also buy cartons of bone broth at Trader Joe's or Walmart.
Ginger, fennel
and peppermint are my other favourite foods
that actually help soothe and Stop bloating
if you're actively bloated.
Those are foods I love to turn to.
You can drink these as teas,
ginger you can obviously cook with,
and fennel is great in like casseroles or soups,
but you can get any of them in tea form as well.
